Wrap your bed in soft, plush warmth with the Sakooon Duvet Comfort Filling from our Rest Easy Collection. Its generous 220 GSM filling gives dependable winter warmth and a balanced, cloud-like loft without feeling heavy.

Shell fabric Microfibre

Frequently asked questions

Is this a duvet cover?
No. This is the duvet filling (insert) that goes inside a duvet cover. The cover is sold separately.

What does 220 GSM mean?
GSM is the weight of the filling per square metre. 220 GSM gives a warm, comfortable layer for winter nights without feeling bulky.

Which size should I choose?
Compare the measurements above with your bed and duvet cover. For a full, fluffy look, choose a filling close to the size of your duvet cover.

products.descriptionHtml:
Bring quiet elegance to your bedroom with the Sakooon Quilted Bed Sheet Set. Made from soft cotton with ultrasonic quilting, it has a raised, embossed pattern that looks rich and stays neat, with no loose threads to pull or fray.

It's light enough for summer nights and adds a cosy layer in winter, so you can use it all year round. The fabric resists wrinkles, so your bed looks freshly made with very little effort.

What's in the set (3 pieces)

  • 1 x Quilted Bed Sheet – 96 x 106 inches (King)
  • 2 x Quilted Pillow Covers – 19 x 29 inches

Why you'll love it

  • Ultrasonic quilting with no loose threads
  • Elegant raised, embossed pattern
  • Lightweight and comfortable in every season
  • Wrinkle-resistant for a neat, ready-made look
  • A wide range of colours to match any bedroom

Specifications

Fabric Cotton
Bed size King
Bed sheet 96 x 106 inches
Pillow covers 19 x 29 inches (2 pcs)
Finish Ultrasonic quilted, embossed
Pieces 3

Care

Machine wash at 40°C. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low.

Frequently asked questions

What is ultrasonic quilting?
Instead of thread, the layers are joined with ultrasonic heat to create the raised pattern. That means no stitches to break and no loose threads, even after many washes.

Can I use it in summer?
Yes. It's lightweight enough for warm nights and adds a soft, cosy layer in winter.

Will it fit my bed?
At 96 x 106 inches, it's made for King size beds. Check our size guide to compare it with your mattress.
